Privacy

Memories, sources, proposals, permissions, and access logs stay on this computer. Search runs locally by default. When you use a cloud extraction model, the text you submit is sent to that service. Memories shared with an authorized agent may leave this device. OMNA does not monitor your clipboard, chats, or system activity, or upload usage logs by default. Whether processing stays offline depends on your configuration. Backups are saved where you choose. Manage older backups and copies held by outside agents separately.
